Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 15

“The all-pervading one takes on neither the wrong nor the good deeds of anyone. Knowledge is covered over by ignorance, and by that creatures are deluded.”

A refusal of the bookkeeping model of divinity. And the diagnosis that follows is not that people are wicked but that something true in them has been covered over.
